rule: The provider runtime belongs to the whole 0S. Founder Command is the owner cockpit over it, not the dependency that makes provider execution exist.
browser_proof_policy: Owner handles browser proof. Codex closure uses code, API, smoke, stress, and receipts.

items.definition_of_done: One shared 0S provider registry exposes configured/missing status for Twilio, Resend, Stripe, PayPal, UPS, Google Merchant, Meta Catalog, TikTok Catalog, Mapbox, R2/storage, Checkr, Certn, social/webhook, commerce HTTP, DNS, FS27, SkyeMail, SkyeNet, OpenAI, Relay13, Cloudflare, Netlify, and Google Calendar without printing secrets.
All provider-backed actions can flow through a shared /api/0s/automation execution lane with shared FS27/SkyGate/Free99 auth, owner approvals, receipts, idempotency, and no app-local admin password.
Owner can approve single actions or scoped automation windows up to 72 hours with provider/action/app/workspace/customer/spend/action-count caps and revoke support.

Twilio SMS/voice status is read from provider vars, execution uses the shared provider spine, consent is enforced, provider IDs/statuses are receipted, and every action mirrors into FS27/Command Bridge.
Every provider action carries customer_id, workspace_id, client_id, app_id, usage_lane, estimated_cost_cents, billable flag, and FS27 mirror metadata for client chargeback.
Failed or blocked provider actions create durable dead-letter receipts; owner retry can execute or sandbox-execute with a readback receipt.
Every provider action writes a Command Bridge event visible by source app, workspace, client, provider, action, and receipt id.

Admin Brain, Content Engine, RouteX, SkyeMail, Relay13, SkyeNet, SkyPay, SovereignDocs, MusicNexus, JobPing, Client App Factory, and SaaS provisioning call the shared provider runtime for external actions.
Non-browser smoke and stress prove provider registry, grants, sandbox execution, real-live gating, consent blocks, retry/dead-letter, FS27 mirror, Command Bridge mirror, and receipt readback.
Closure/truth/valuation artifacts are regenerated after provider runtime and app-lane adoption receipts are green.
